DeterminationBasis: T14-005 requires both predecessor and successor to remain identifiable and linked through explicit lineage, with predecessor, successor and chain evidence preserved. This directly establishes that a successor normative artifact identifies its predecessor.

Existing T16 controls address matrix completeness, requirement statuses and conformance traceability, but no existing T16 control enforces the structural invariant that each matrix entry identifies exactly one normative requirement. A dedicated one-entry/one-requirement matrix control is therefore required.
